texts.name: Kokuri
texts.biography: Kokuri is an old fox who has lived so long that his fur has turned white and his tails have stopped counting themselves. He serves the Inari shrine as a healer and diviner, reading the future in the flicker of fox-fire and the tracks of the rice harvest. The younger fox shamans revere him as a grandfather and come to him to learn the deeper spells. In battle he guides their aim, and their arrows of fox-fire rarely miss.

specialty.description: Increases the Speed of any Fox Shamans or Tenko by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
specialty.name: Fox Shamans
